Working draft

Personal data
protection.

This document is a working informational summary. A complete legal notice requires the data controller’s details, their contact information, the retention period for emails and the contractual documentation of processors. Until the operator confirms these details, this is not a complete privacy policy.

Verified technical status

What the website
actually uses.

The website is static and hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub states that it logs IP addresses when Pages is visited for security purposes. This website has no analytics or marketing scripts, does not store data in localStorage and does not load remote Google Fonts.

A third-party service loads only after a deliberate action by the visitor — clicking the button to load the map. The contact page only opens the visitor’s email application; the website itself does not send any message.

What still needs to be added

This notice is not complete
without these details.

The operator must confirm its legal name, company identification number, registered office, contact for data-subject rights, the correct recipient of emails, the retention period for messages in the email inbox and the procedure for deleting them. These details are intentionally not invented here.

Under Article 13 GDPR, an information notice should state in particular the controller, purposes and legal basis, recipients, retention period, individuals’ rights and, where applicable, the mechanism for transfers to third countries. The legal basis for a particular method of contact must be determined by the controller according to its actual purpose; it cannot be replaced by a universal “I agree to GDPR” checkbox.

Contact by email

The website does not
send messages itself.

The website has no contact form and does not pass messages to an external form service. Clicking the email address only opens the visitor’s email application.

If a visitor sends an email from their own application, subsequent processing takes place outside this website. Before publishing a complete notice, the operator must determine the recipient of messages, their retention period and the deletion procedure.

Marketing communications

Emails without
marketing.

This website does not collect email addresses for marketing, distribute a newsletter or promise any automatic offer.

If a newsletter is introduced later, it requires separate, voluntary and unticked consent, a record that consent was given and a working unsubscribe option in every marketing message. Czech law on commercial communications requires prior consent, with a limited exception for existing customers and the sender’s own similar offers.

Recipients and transfers

More than the data
on the page.

GitHub Pages and, after a click, Google Maps are the services currently used. The website does not pass messages to an external form service. If a visitor sends an email from their own application, subsequent processing takes place outside this website. GitHub states that processing can take place outside the EEA with appropriate safeguards. Google states that it uses global servers and mechanisms for international transfers.

The Google map on this website loads only after a click. Google notes that its services may use cookies and similar technologies. If analytics or marketing is added, a genuinely functional option to give and withdraw consent must be introduced before it starts.

Visitors’ rights

How to exercise
your rights.

GDPR provides rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and, in relevant cases, objection; it also provides the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The controller must publish a verified contact for exercising these rights. The email address info@labelleboutique.cz is currently only the boutique’s publicly listed contact, not a confirmed contact for the controller responsible for personal data protection.

Supporting materials for this draft

Sources that need
to be verified.

GDPR in EUR-Lex is the source for legal bases and information obligations. On cookies, this draft follows guidance from the Czech Data Protection Authority. The hosting and transfer arrangements must be checked against the GitHub Pages documentation and GitHub’s policies.

Google’s description of cookies is relevant to the map. These supporting materials do not themselves replace a processor agreement or the operator’s assessment.
